verdict.rationale: Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md and YAML frontmatter (e.g. skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md), which matches the Agent Skills layout. A runtime probe installed the tdd skill and its frontmatter (name: tdd) read back cleanly. The same skill set is documented as installing into Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and Cursor via plugin marketplaces and the vendor-neutral `npx skills` installer, so the folders are clearly usable beyond one vendor. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim of conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, documented frontmatter fields beyond `name`, and independent hands-on validation in a non-Claude agent.
